book.name: Lukas
book.title: Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole na tuka Lukas susura na

content: Ramatua Yesus naneta no mana susu bea esa, nade Sakeos
Basa boe ma Yesus asa laꞌo raroo, ara masoꞌ tuka kota Yeriko.
Nai na hapu lahenda esa nade Sakeos. Ria nana malaka mana susu bea fee mana pareta Roma. Ma ria lahenda kamasuꞌi.
Ana namanene Yesus sakaꞌ nesiꞌ na, boe ma ana nahiiꞌ nita Yesus. Tehuu ana ta bisa nita no matetuꞌ fa, huu fo lahenda dodouꞌ eo ra Yesus, ma ria ao-ina na eetuanaꞌ a esan.
Huu ria na de ana nalai naꞌuluꞌ, boe ma ae neuꞌ ai huuꞌ esa lain nai enoꞌ a suu na, fo Yesus sakaꞌ nesiꞌ na a.
Yesus losa ai ria huu na, boe ma Ana relu leo lain neu. Basa de naloo Sakeos nae, “Sakeos! Onda leo! Malaiꞌ a, huu fo faiꞌ ia Au nau tuli o uma ma.”
Sakeos noi namakokoaꞌ a. Boe ma ana onda lai-lai, basa de ana noo Yesus leo uma na neu. Dale na namahoꞌo naan seli.
Tehuu lahenda kadodou inaꞌ ara ramumuu rae, “Ae! Sakeos ia, nana lahenda tadaluꞌ! Ubeaꞌ taon de Yesus neu tuli uma na?! Basa lahenda ra bubuluꞌ so!”

Losa uma boe ma, Sakeos foa napadeiꞌ nai Yesus mata na, de ana dedea nae, “Papa Mesen! Mulai neme faiꞌ ia mai, au bati dua hata-heto kara katemaꞌ, fo fee lahenda manatoꞌa-manataaꞌ ara babatiꞌ esa. Maneniko au parna susu bea ala lenaꞌ, au fee faliꞌ asa laiꞌ haa.”
Yesus nataa nae, “Malole a. Faiꞌ ia Manetualain fee soda-moleꞌ neuꞌ o mo kileoboboki mara katemaꞌ, huu fo o mamahere neuꞌ Manetualain sama leoꞌ baꞌi Abraham.
Huu fo Manetualain nadenu neuꞌ Au dadi uuꞌ Ana Lahenda nai dae-bafoꞌ ia. Au mai nana saka lahenda fo sala-mopo neme Manetualain eno na mai, ela poꞌi-tata a si.”
Tutuiꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ ata fo ator natalolole malaka na doi-talin

Faiꞌ ria nana lahenda dodouꞌ ramanene neuꞌ Yesus. Ara raneneaꞌ kota Yerusalem. Ma sira dale nara rae Ana leo Yerusalem neu, nana ela pareta sama leoꞌ Maneꞌ fo Manetualain helu basa so a. Boe ma Yesus tui fee si dedea nasasamaꞌ esa bali,
nae, “Lahenda bauinaꞌ esa sakaꞌ leo nusa dea neu, fo ara feo lesu ni dadi mane. Basa sona dei ana fali leo nusa na neu.
Fai fo ana nahehere aon sakaꞌ laꞌo, ana naloo na ata ni sanahulu, de fee si lahenda esa na doi lilopilas esa.
Ana pareta nae, ‘Emi pake doiꞌ ia ra fo papalele meniꞌ. Faiꞌ bea au fali mai, emi mafada au emi hapu doi bunaꞌ hida.” Basa boe ma ana laꞌo.
Tehuu lahenda nusa isi nara eteꞌ ao nara roon. De ara radenu lahenda tuka reu rafada rae, ‘Ami ta mahiiꞌ lahenda ia dadi maneꞌ fee ami fa.’

Leo mae leoꞌ na, tehuu ara feo lesu ni nai na. Basa boe ma ana fali neun. Losa uma, boe ma naloo na lahenda mana noi kasanahuluꞌ sira, de natane si nae, ‘Emi hapu bunaꞌ hida neme doi lilopilas fo riꞌ au fee emi a?’
Lahenda mana noi masososaꞌ a nafada nae, ‘Papa mane! Au onto laiꞌ sanahulu so, neme doi poko fo au sipo a!’
Boe ma maneꞌ a nafada ni nae, ‘Malole a! O ia, nana lahenda mana noi malole. Huu no au bisa amahere neuꞌ o neniꞌ hihii-nanauꞌ aanaꞌ ara, huu ria na de besaꞌ ia au soꞌu o fo pareta kota sanahulu.’
Lahenda mana noi kadua a nafada nae, ‘Papa maneꞌ! Au onto doi lilopilas lima neme doi poko fo au sipo a.’
Basa, boe ma maneꞌ a io ni nae, ‘Malole a! Kalu leoꞌ na, sona au soꞌu o fo pareta kota lima.’
Tehuu lahenda mana noi katelu a neni faliꞌ ria doi lilopilas na. Ana nafada nae, ‘Papa ia doi ma! Au poti an, de afuni matalololen ela bosoꞌ mopo ni.
Au tao leo naꞌ, huu fo au biiꞌ. Au bubuluꞌ papa nana lahenda bita-bataꞌ. Huu no papa mahiiꞌ hai hata fo papa ta nuum fa, ma etu-seu hata fo papa ta sele-tande fa.’

Maneꞌ a namanene leoꞌ na, boe ma nasapaa ni nae, ‘O ia, manori taꞌ! O dedea-nafadam huku seluꞌ ao-ina ma so. O bubuluꞌ au ia nana lahenda bita-bataꞌ, de hai hata fo au ta anuu ni, ma etu-seu hata fo au ta sele-tande ni.
Kalu leoꞌ na, sona ubeaꞌ taon de o ta muu peda doiꞌ ia neuꞌ bank a fa? Fo ela faiꞌ fo au fali mai ka, au bisa hapu buna na. Leo mae bai anaꞌ boe malole a.’
Boe ma maneꞌ ria nadenu lahenda fekeꞌ manai na ra nae, ‘Hai ma doi ni ria, fo feen leo lahenda mana noi fo bisinaꞌ a ana onto laiꞌ sanahulu a.’
Tehuu ana nadedea laka nae, ‘Papa! Lahenda ria hapu nan nana dai so. Bosoꞌ boe fee tamba seluꞌ ana bali.’

Tehuu maneꞌ a nataa nae, ‘Dodoo matalolole! Kalu lahenda bea urus nalelaꞌ hata fo ria homu a, neuꞌ ko ana hapu tamba seluꞌ bali. Tehuu lahenda bea ao na mataꞌ a urus, neuꞌ ko hai fali basa hata fo ana nanuu a.
Besaꞌ ia au musunook fo ta rahiiꞌ au, dadi mane fee si a, moo si leo iaꞌ mai fo tati heni si naiꞌ au mata ka.’ ”
Ramatua Yesus masoꞌ leo kota Yerusalem neu
Yesus tui basa, boe ma ara laꞌo raroo leo kota Yerusalem reu. Yesus laꞌo nesiꞌ uluꞌ.
Faiꞌ fo ara sakaꞌ raneneaꞌ roo koroꞌ dua, siꞌ Betfage no Betania, fo nai lete Saitun suu na, boe ma Ana nadenu ana mana tuka dean dua reu rauluꞌ.
Ana nadenu si nae, “Emi dua leo koroꞌ fo nai mata ria meu. Neuꞌ ko emi mita keledei anaꞌ esa mana hekeꞌ nai na. Lahenda bei ta parna saꞌe ni fa. Emi dua sefi man fo hela meni ni leo iaꞌ mai.
Tehuu maneniko lahenda ratane rae, ‘Ubeaꞌ taon de emi sefi heni keledei ria tali na?’ sona mafada si mae, ‘Ami Ramatua ma nau pake ni.’ ”
Basa de, dua si reu, boe ma raneta ro keledei anaꞌ ria, sama leoꞌ Yesus nafada na.
Dua si bei sefi heni keledei anaꞌ ria tali na, boe ma manuuꞌ a natane si nae, “Ubeaꞌ taon de emi sefi poꞌi keledei ia?”
Boe ma ara rataa rae, “Ami Ramatua ma noi pake ni.”
Manuuꞌ a sipoꞌ no malole, basa de dua si hela reni keledei anaꞌ ria leo Yesus neu. Ara bela lafa nara reuꞌ keledei anaꞌ ria koti ai na. Boe ma rasasaꞌe Yesus neuꞌ lain,
Lahenda dodouꞌ hai ra lafa nara, ma lafa ana nasaa nara, de bela si reuꞌ enoꞌ lain, fo sipoꞌ Yesus sama leoꞌ sipoꞌ lahenda bauinaꞌ a.
Faiꞌ fo Ana mulai onda neme lete Saitun a mai, boe ma lahenda kadodou inaꞌ sira roo Yesus ana mana tuka dea nara mulai heꞌi ma io-oa neuꞌ Manetualain, nana huu basa tanda kuasa fo ara rita ni a.
Ara heꞌi rae,

content.text: “Ia nana, Maneꞌ fo Manetualain nadenu ni mai!
Besaꞌ ia, lahenda dae-bafoꞌ a bisa mole-dame ro Ramatuaꞌ a nai nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a.
Io-oa neuꞌ Ramatuaꞌ fo natuuꞌ pareta nai lalai madema ina a.”

content: Tehuu hapu lahenda Farisi rai lahenda kadodou inaꞌ sira talada. Ara rafada Yesus rae, “Papa Mesen! Masaꞌai si fo bosoꞌ ara heꞌi leoꞌ na, huu fo ia seli uukuꞌ a so!”
Tehuu Yesus nataa nae, “Ae! Au afada memaꞌ! Maneniko lahenda ia ra ta rahahara fa, sona batu ra io-oa neuꞌ Manetualain!”
Ramatua Yesus dola fee Yerusalem
Faiꞌ fo ara sakaꞌ masoꞌ leo Yerusalem reu, Yesus nita kota ria, boe ma Ana dola,
nae, “Adoo, lahenda Yerusalem, emin! Au nau faiꞌ ia emi sipo mole-dame fo Au uni a. Tehuu no emi ta taoꞌ daleꞌ neuꞌ Manetualain, besaꞌ ia emi mababakoꞌ, de mole-dame ria dooꞌ a neme emi mai so.
Neuꞌ ko emi musunoo mara poꞌa dae feo kota a tembok na, basa nana ara masoꞌ reu suu emi.

Ara rarerefaꞌ heni emi kota ma nabebelaꞌ no dae a, basa nana raisa katemaꞌ emi mo ana mara. Ara ta foa ela batu esa napadei boeꞌ, nana huu Manetualain mai so fo nau fee emi sodaꞌ a, tehuu emi ta nau malelaꞌ Ana fa!”
Ramatua Yesus masoꞌ leo Uma Mamaso Ina a neu

Basa boe ma Yesus masoꞌ leo Uma Mamaso Ina a daleꞌ neu. Nai uma ria mata na, lahenda ra taon dadi neuꞌ pasar so fo raseꞌo banda tutunu-hohotuꞌ. Yesus nita leoꞌ na, boe ma Ana neu usi heni si reme naꞌ mai.
Ana nasapaa nae, “Manetualain mana nesi mata nara duiꞌ memaꞌ rae,

content.text: ela basa lahenda ra bisa mai hule-haradoi nai ia.’

content: Tehuu emi tao ni dadi neuꞌ parampok ara mamana nabuan.”
Basa ria, boe ma tuka-tuka faiꞌ Yesus leo Uma Mamaso Ina a neu, fo nanori-nafada nai na. Tehuu malaka agama Yahudi a Malaka bau-ina nara, mesen agama ma lasi Yahudi ra, rasaka enoꞌ fo nau raisa Ni.
Tehuu ara ta hapu enoꞌ fa, nana huu lahenda kadodou inaꞌ sira ramahoꞌo raan seli nau ramanene Yesus dedea-nafadan.

footnotes.text: Dedea Yunani a mana duiꞌ nae ai huuꞌ sukomorea. Ai huuꞌ rupaꞌ ria neꞌes ana Indonesia poꞌ dulu.
Duduiꞌ dedea Yunani a nae, ana fee si, ‘mina sanahulu’ Mina esa, sona, riꞌ denari natun esa, do tukan esa fai nonoin natun esa kadi na.

Nai na, lahenda bauinaꞌ ara saꞌe dara, tehuu lahenda aanaꞌ ara saꞌe keledei. Ramatua Yesus saꞌe keledei, nanadadi tanda neuꞌ dale naloe-nadae ao Na. Nai Sakaria 9:9; ma hapu heheluꞌ esa nae lahenda Israel ra mane na saꞌe keledei sakaꞌ mai.
